wrong_setting: He sits at the very front of the bus facing the windscreen beside a dashboard and radio, like the driver's position, instead of at a side window with seats ahead of him.
notes: Repaint from directly behind his seat so only his head and shoulders show above the seat back. Turn him toward a side window with his face hidden and put worn seats ahead of him. Remove the dashboard, the radio and the extra boy, and swap the khaki shoulder satchel for a simple backpack.
